categories.label: Starting a Business
categories.description: First-time business licenses, registrations, and permits

types.name: Restaurant / Food Service
types.filing: Local health department plus the city or county license desk

types.name: Contractor License
types.filing: State contractor board and/or the city or county

types.name: Home Health Agency
types.filing: State health department or health-care facility board

categories.label: Financial Services
categories.description: Lending, money transmission, debt collection, and other financial licenses

types.name: Consumer Lender
types.filing: State banking, DFI, or consumer-credit agency — usually NMLS

types.name: Mortgage Lender/Broker
types.filing: State mortgage regulator through NMLS (SAFE Act)

types.name: Money Transmitter
types.filing: FinCEN MSB registration plus a state money-transmitter license on NMLS

types.name: Collection Agency
types.filing: State collection board, banking department, or secretary of state — some states have no license

types.name: Payday / Small Dollar Lender
types.filing: State banking, DFI, or consumer-credit agency — usually NMLS

types.name: Debt Buyer
types.filing: Often the same desk as collection; confirm the state’s debt-buyer category

types.name: Cryptocurrency License
types.filing: Often a money-transmitter license; New York adds a BitLicense for some activity

categories.label: Insurance & Professional
categories.description: Insurance adjusters, professional licenses, and specialty permits

types.name: Insurance Adjuster
types.filing: State department of insurance, usually through NIPR
